claimBoundary: Deterministic product regressions derived from real defects/tasks. This suite does not measure agent/model quality; W15 owns agentic model evaluation.

target.testName: meneruskan GET MCP workspace query valid yang didukung Connect

cases.expected: A valid workspaceId query reaches Connect instead of being rejected by the Ai proxy.

target.testName: redirect owner tidak diikuti sambil membawa bearer token

cases.expected: Owner redirects fail closed and never carry the internal bearer token across a followed redirect.

target.testName: menolak literal dan encoded dot-segment escape

cases.expected: Literal and encoded path traversal attempts are rejected before an owner URL is constructed.

target.testName: redirect owner tidak diikuti sambil membawa bearer token

cases.expected: Flow owner redirects fail closed while requests containing the internal bearer token are in flight.

target.testName: meneruskan SSE ke Hub dengan bearer, no-store, dan redirect fail-closed

cases.expected: Realtime voice uses no-store and redirect=error while forwarding the internal bearer token to Hub.

target.testName: menolak localBaseUrl yang keluar dari loopback/private

cases.expected: Public localBaseUrl values are rejected by default so local routing cannot be silently redirected to a public host.

target.testName: menolak tag model lokal yang mutable tanpa digest terpin

cases.expected: Mutable local model aliases are rejected unless an immutable digest is supplied.

target.testName: meneruskan transient credential test tanpa mengubah secret body

cases.expected: A transient provider credential test reaches Connect without silently mutating the secret payload or persisting it in the browser path.

target.testName: target local adalah input valid dan tetap diteruskan ke Hub

cases.expected: Explicit Local chat selection remains a valid product path and is forwarded to Hub unchanged.

target.testName: body valid → diteruskan ke Hub POST /v1/memory/forget

cases.expected: The Forget product path reaches the authoritative Hub memory-forget endpoint and returns its invalidation evidence.

target.testName: satu owner wajib gagal tetap menghasilkan snapshot eksplisit degraded

cases.expected: A failed required Phase 4 owner produces an explicit degraded snapshot instead of a false healthy state.

target.testName: Sync lokal yang tidak dijalankan tetap terlihat tetapi tidak mendegradasi fleet Phase 4

cases.expected: Optional Sync remains visible when down but does not incorrectly degrade the required Phase 4 fleet.
